MA27.title: Equation candidate: L2 (ridge) shrinkage on the 53-signal cross-section, and why it is not the rejected schemes in a costume
MA27.evidence_needed: gamma selected on a strictly prior window and never on the scoring window; a C-control that the arm is not the incumbent (rank correlation).
MA27.verification: CONSTRUCTION, EXACTLY: over the 53 signals already in per_signal (not the 7 theme z-scores), form the within-date standardised Z, the second-moment matrix Sigma of signal-portfolio returns and the mean vector mu; estimate b = (Sigma + gamma*I)^-1 mu; score as Z*b. NOT S5 (James-Stein on 7 theme MEAN ICs - no Sigma in it). NOT MLCOMB (a non-linear interaction search over 7 themes that REVERSED out of sample; this is linear, convex, one hyper-parameter). NOT the eight _weight_schemes (risk-parity and max-ir-decorr do use Sigma, but at the THEME level, after the theme mean has destroyed the within-theme covariance structure - S16 proved that layer collapses information, since splitting one input into two is a rank identity there).
MA27.trial_cost: 1 if a single pre-committed gamma rule; 2 for both decide/measure directions, which the shipped gate requires. N 224 -> 226 moves the HLZ hurdle 3.28988 -> 3.29277, i.e. 0.003 of a t.
MA27.kill_condition: REJECTED if top_decile_alpha fails the 1.95pp calibrated margin in EITHER half, or if within-date rank correlation against the deployed composite exceeds 0.97 (S24 landed at 0.9907, S15 at 0.9879). A gamma chosen anywhere on the scoring window VOIDS the arm outright.
MA27.note: Prior stated in advance as this project requires: I expect REJECTED at ~75/25. Everything in the weighting family has failed by margins up to 79x and flat 1/7 has never been beaten. The reason to run it is that it is the ONE member of the family whose mechanism - a covariance term at the SIGNAL layer - has never been tested, and S16 proved that layer is where information is destroyed. External support: a 2025 replication applied exactly this estimator to JKP Global Factor Data (which X8 already used and D3 records as present) and found the dense ridge arm's out-of-sample R2 comparable to the original.

A surface that displays the refusal count makes that failure mode LOUD, with users as the guard. Copy risk runs the opposite way from the usual: a refusal means the MODEL failed, not the name.

MA30.title: HYPOTHESIS - Tenure on the hot list
MA30.verification: Measured pieces: S22's Kaplan-Meier top-decile tenure (median ONE rebalance) and S14-WIDTH's incumbent share (0.359 -> 0.701 at width 0.30).
MA30.note: Discloses churn, which is the most misleading thing about a ranked list refreshed daily. MUST NOT claim long-tenured names are better - S22 measured a term structure of the SIGNAL, not of tenure, and no arm has tested tenure as a predictor. A REGISTER IS REQUIRED THE MOMENT ANYONE SORTS OR FILTERS BY IT, because that converts a disclosure into a screen.

MA31.title: Cremers-Weinbaum matched-strike put-call parity deviation - the largest un-run item either prior audit named
registers: U2 (closed PARTIAL for exactly this reason)
MA31.evidence_needed: Matched call/put pairs on identical strike and expiry from the raw chains; a strictly-before join to the rebalance date; the covered-subsample split.
MA31.verification: U2 declined it in writing: it is 'Cremers-Weinbaum's ACTUAL measure and the largest effect the section cites (51 bps/week)', it needs matched pairs from the raw chains, and the task forbade new features - so U2 closed PARTIAL rather than DONE. V6-OPT has since measured the cache at 1,288,750 puts against 1,288,751 calls with ZERO tickers lacking puts, so the blocker is gone.
MA31.kill_condition: Fails X7's calibrated 2.71 theme-IC bar in either half of the covered subsample; or the incremental-IC-vs-incumbents control (the PEAD/U2 template) shows it is a repackaged incumbent.
MA31.note: Constraint: the derived layer spans 2016-01 -> 2025-12, so 29 of 69 dates carry ZERO coverage and all are early - the covered-subsample protocol binds (S18/U2/U3/V6-OPT, four precedents). A pass on 20-date halves is not the same object as a pass on 34-date halves.

MA32.title: Open-vs-close decomposition of options volume (Ge-Lin-Pearson) - buildable from open-interest change
MA32.evidence_needed: Daily open-interest change per contract, signed against volume.
MA32.verification: O14 tested signed_volume, pc_flow_imbalance, block_share, unusual_volume and sweep_share - none is the O/S ratio, and none decomposes opening from closing interest. The published result concentrates the effect in CALL PURCHASES THAT OPEN NEW POSITIONS, which needs only option volume and OI change - both in data/options. The full O/S ratio additionally needs STOCK volume, which per MA25 exists for only ~290 names.
MA32.kill_condition: Fails its own within-date permutation p95 in either half; or fails the incremental-IC control against the momentum inputs (PEAD's template - 89% orthogonality that predicts nothing was what killed pead_car).
MA32.note: Mind B4: the -1 open-interest sentinel reached the backtest untreated once already. Any OI-difference feature must handle it explicitly or it will manufacture flow out of a sentinel.

MA33.title: The monthly theme panel - the rebuild that unlocks the whole text/LLM class at once
registers: X7 (floors are panel-specific and would need re-deriving)
MA33.evidence_needed: A monthly panel, its own MDE, and a re-derivation of any calibrated floor quoted against it.
MA33.verification: The 2024-2026 LLM-signal literature is large but weak and unstandardised - the surveys themselves say signals are 'not yet widely standardized or consistently benchmarked' and almost nothing is point-in-time clean. The project owns a real MD&A corpus (195 + 418 names, 15,893 filing pairs) and an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. What it lacks is a MONTHLY panel, and S19 proved a quarterly one cannot detect an effect of this size.
MA33.trial_cost: the rebuild itself charges nothing; each arm scored on it charges normally
MA33.kill_condition: If the monthly panel's MDE still exceeds the effect sizes in the literature this class reports, close the class rather than testing arms against it.
MA33.note: CAUTION: X7's floors are calibrated for THIS panel/universe/69 dates. A monthly panel is a different object and every calibrated bar quoted against it would be an EXTRAPOLATION - the error U2 avoided by declining to quote 2.2837 on a covered subsample. Budget the re-calibration as part of the rebuild, not after it.

MA35.title: Git corrupts every PDF in this repository on checkout, and it has already done it
MA35.verification: MEASURED. .gitattributes deliberately declines `* text=auto` and sets NO binary rule for anything, so under core.autocrlf=true every file falls back to git's NUL-byte heuristic. reportlab output has no NUL bytes. VALQUO_LIVE_AUDIT.pdf: working copy 48,180 bytes with 308 CRLF sequences, pypdf reports 'incorrect startxref pointer(1)' and recovers by rebuilding. Valquo_Edge_Audit_and_Test_Catalogue.pdf is clean ONLY because at 7.8 MB it contains NUL bytes by accident and git guessed binary. After adding `*.pdf binary` and re-checking out: 47,872 bytes, 0 CRLF, no warning.
MA35.note: THE ONE DECLARED SCOPE DEVIATION OF THIS AUDIT: fixed in place with a single line, because deliverable #3 was otherwise knowingly broken on arrival, and the same line repairs audit #2's deliverable. Deliberately NOT `* text=auto`, which .gitattributes documents as the change that would renormalise the tree and conflict with every open branch. Same class as B12 and S25: behaviour that depends on an accident of the data rather than a stated rule, so it works until it does not and nothing says which case you are in.

MA34.title: Write the post-publication decay prior into the contract's expectations, at zero trial cost
MA34.evidence_needed: None - it is an expectation, written before the window accrues.
MA34.verification: McLean-Pontiff and successors find post-publication premia decay ~one-third as institutions trade them. R1 established that size, quality and momentum ARE the standard premia here (SMB +0.39 t 3.84, RMW +0.30 t 4.49, UMD +0.18 t 3.49) while value and capital_discipline are NOT (HML t 1.08, CMA t 1.08). So a decay prior applies to PART of the composite and not the rest.
MA34.kill_condition: n/a - an expectation, not a hypothesis test
MA34.note: This is the cheapest item in the whole audit and the only one that gets MORE valuable the sooner it is done: an expectation written after the window has accrued is worthless. The forward track is the instrument that would see it.
